select tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID id, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID text from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl where tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F36} and tfpdl.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} and tfpdl.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null
and tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID like '%'|| #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%'
union all select tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID id, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID text from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID where tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F36} and tfpdl.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} and tfpdl.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and tfpdl.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null
and tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID like '%'|| #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%'

select f.FINPROD_ID finprodId, f.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, f.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, f.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, f.VDATE vdate, f.MDATE mdate, fa.REF_ENTITY refEntity, f.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, fa.REF_SEC refSec from FIN_PRODUCT f left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fa on fa.FINPROD_ID = f.FINPROD_ID where f.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} or f.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId}

select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.VDATE vDate, fp.MDATE mDate, fpd.REF_ENTITY refEntity, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE creditEvent, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE paBussType, tfpdl.CREDIT_EVENT_HAPPENED_DATE creditEventHappenedDate, tfpdl.CREDIT_EVENT_RESOLVE_DATE creditEventResolveDate, tfpdl.SETTLE_METHOD settleMethod, tfpdl.DELIVER_BOND deliverBond, tfpdl.DEVIDENT_DATE deliverDate, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, fp.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.VDATE vDate, fp.MDATE mDate, fpd.REF_ENTITY refEntity, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE creditEvent, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE paBussType, tfpdl.CREDIT_EVENT_HAPPENED_DATE creditEventHappenedDate, tfpdl.CREDIT_EVENT_RESOLVE_DATE creditEventResolveDate, tfpdl.SETTLE_METHOD settleMethod, tfpdl.DELIVER_BOND deliverBond, tfpdl.DEVIDENT_DATE deliverDate, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, fp.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select tfpdl.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID acctNo, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(tfpdl.SHARE_AMT, 0) / 10000 repNomCapi, nvl(tfpdl.DELIVER_BOND_AMOUNT, 0) / 10000 deliverBondAmount, nvl(tfpdl.TRADE_AMT, 0) / 10000 deliveryAmount, tfpdl.REMARK remark from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on tfpdl.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where tfpdl.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select tfpdl.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID acctNo, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(tfpdl.SHARE_AMT, 0) / 10000 repNomCapi, nvl(tfpdl.DELIVER_BOND_AMOUNT, 0) / 10000 deliverBondAmount, nvl(tfpdl.TRADE_AMT, 0) / 10000 deliveryAmount, tfpdl.REMARK remark from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on tfpdl.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where tfpdl.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select p.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) / 10000 repNomCapi, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) / 10000 deliverBondAmount from PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE p left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = p.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = p.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.REC_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on p.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} and p.CDATE = #{tradeDate} and p.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001'

select p.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) / 10000 repNomCapi, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) / 10000 deliverBondAmount from PTL_SEC_POSITION p left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = p.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = p.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.REC_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on p.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} and p.CDATE = #{tradeDate} and p.HODING_TYPE = '03'
select distinct fa.REF_SEC from FIN_PRODUCT f left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fa on fa.FINPROD_ID = f.FINPROD_ID where f.ISSUER = #{refEntity,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fa.REF_SEC is not null
